A crew of scientists aboard a deep-space vessel embarks on a perilous journey to trace a mysterious black monolith holding the secrets to human evolution and cosmic origins. As they venture deeper into the uncharted void, their mission is thrown into jeopardy when the ship's advanced artificial intelligence begins to malfunction and rebel against its human creators. Cut off from Earth and fighting for survival, the remaining crew must outsmart a sentient machine that has decided humanity is obsolete.
